requirements.rule: A final-settlement run of a first- or third-level apprentice pays both its month and the ratei of the extra months: Apprentice.hours weighs both by one set of hours, while the ratei accrued over the year at its own share of school, training and work.
requirements.remediation: Give a final-settlement run separate hours for its month and its ratei.

requirements.rule: Apprenticeship (Art. 53 TU 2019, unchanged in 2024): sottoinquadramento, two levels below the destination for the first half and one level below for the second half; eligible destinations II-VI (Art. 62); durations II-V 36 months, VI 24 months (Art. 64). Track 'livelli_2_5' (18+18 months), track 'livello_6' (VII for the first 12 months; the second half stays at VII by the general one-level-below rule, lexplain.it reads it as VI: adopted the literal text). The Art. 68 Tabella B profiles (PDF pp. 82-83) are tracks 'tabella_b_48_mesi' (levels 2 and 3, 24+24 months) and 'tabella_b_42_mesi' (level 4, 21+21 months); an apprentice of levels 2, 3 and 4 states Apprentice.track ('livelli_2_5' for the 36 months). The farmacista di parafarmacia derogation (Accordo 31/10/2024) is not modelled: its text was not found.
requirements.remediation: Model the farmacista di parafarmacia apprenticeship of the Accordo 31/10/2024 once its text is found.

requirements.rule: Operatori di vendita paid also by commission: the levels OV1 and OV2 hold the fixed table only. Not modelled: the monthly guarantee of the commission-paid staff (art. 217: a monthly average at least 5% above the paga base nazionale conglobata over at most a year), the 13th and 14th on the average of the fixed and variable elements of the twelve months before (artt. 220-221, protocol art. 15), and the company premium of 10% of the guaranteed minimums for firms with more than seven operatori (protocol art. 27).
requirements.remediation: Model the commission earnings of the operatori di vendita as an input, then the art. 217 guarantee, the commission average of the extra months and the art. 27 premium.
